Romy Jiang

See I’ve had soufflé pancakes before that are either too fluffy and practically raw on the inside or not fluffing enough and borderline crunchy. At Kori the pancakes are js the right balance of super fluffy and thick but also fully cooked throughout. Not to mention the way they cook it with the metal sheet on top ensures the oil soaks back inside the pancake instead of evaporating, giving it more of that deliciously decadent aroma. Also the variety of flavors is genuinely insane - their cream cheese for the creme brûlée goes insanely well with the crunchy sugar shell on top, the mochi is perfectly stretchy for the strawberry mochi and the chocolate with the chocolate cream is the perfect mix of just enough cocoa flavour without being too sweet or bitter. No other soufflé pancake shop manages this kind of variety whilst making everything were rly balanced and not overpowering the main part of the dessert which is of course the fluffy pancakes.
